findings: Complete original single-tile scope is preserved: arbitrary dimensions/strides, fp16 A/B, both fp32/fp16 output branches and original output-offset injectivity. Both tiles load before writes, preserving logical input/output aliasing.

Three public contracts cover callback values, concrete output casts with an explicit dot, and a full sequential software bit dot. Dot software order and direct narrowing are explicit; the six reference checks exclude source and its execution.

The16x16 transposed/aliased/gapped-output witness distinguishes fp32 product0x3f804008 from half0x3c02 and includes frame checks. It is a fixed supporting software witness, not the primary universal theorem.
Offline native WGMMA accumulation, casts/FTZ/NaN behavior, block-pointer byte addresses/allocation bounds and launch remain unbound. Original main/Python source hashes match.
